findings.governingReading: 出すわよ answers なに勝手に結論出してんだ; it is Rin's conclusion, not Sakura's past offense.
findings.explanation: Rin affirming she will reach a conclusion becomes asserting Sakura already committed wrong.

findings.highlight: It'll save the people that she would have killed.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜も、桜の手にかかる人たちも救われる
findings.governingReading: 桜も、桜の手にかかる人たちも makes the claimed mercy two-sided.
findings.explanation: Rin's claim of saving both Sakura and potential victims drops Sakura.

findings.highlight: She isn't saying that death would save Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 死が救いになる、という事ではなく
findings.governingReading: 死が救いになる、という事ではなく limits Shirou's own assessment: correct in saving lives, not in death being salvation.
findings.explanation: Shirou excluding death-as-salvation from his agreement becomes denying that Rin says it.

findings.highlight: I've always accepted, but always wanted to deny deep down.
findings.evidenceJa: ずっと否定してきて、心の奥で、受け入れていた
findings.governingReading: ずっと否定してきて followed by 心の奥で受け入れていた distinguishes outward rejection from inward acceptance.
findings.explanation: Long denial with hidden acceptance becomes habitual acceptance with hidden denial.

findings.evidenceJa: その結果がどうなるかは、これから考える
findings.governingReading: その結果がどうなるかは、これから考える leaves consequences unresolved after admitting he cannot save everyone.
findings.explanation: Deferring thought about consequences becomes promising to find a way.

findings.highlight: I'll blast you so hard you go flying outside.
findings.evidenceJa: 根元から吹っ飛ばされて
findings.governingReading: 手を離して、さもないと、根元から吹っ飛ばされて is a threat to the arm he holds her with, followed by being sent outside.
findings.explanation: Threatening the restraining arm at its root becomes blasting Shirou generally.

findings.highlight: She might have accidentally broken the glass.
findings.evidenceJa: 仕方なく窓ガラスを割ったのだろう
findings.governingReading: 嵌め殺し explains why she had no choice but to break it to escape; 仕方なく is necessity, not accident.
findings.explanation: Breaking a fixed window out of necessity becomes accidentally breaking glass.

findings.highlight: she will most assuredly attack her.
findings.evidenceJa: 間違いなく間桐桜を手にかける
findings.governingReading: Kotomine predicts that Rin will kill Sakura if she finds her first.
findings.explanation: Kotomine's prediction that Rin will kill Sakura becomes a prediction of an attack. The urgency remains, but the stated outcome is less definite.

findings.highlight: I run back and forth through the cloudy night.
findings.governingReading: 闇雲に is the adverb blindly/haphazardly, not the weather noun cloud.
findings.explanation: Aimless running is rendered as running through a cloudy night.

findings.highlight: Mixed in the liquid was a Whisper spell
findings.governingReading: 暗示のようなもの describes something like suggestion; no named spell or mixture composition is identified.
findings.explanation: Sakura's comparison to suggestion becomes a named Whisper spell mixed into liquid.

findings.highlight: Who I can't bear the thought of losing.
findings.evidenceJa: 失うことさえ、思いつかなかった
findings.governingReading: 失うことさえ、思いつかなかった says loss had not occurred to him, a retrospective blind spot.
findings.explanation: Never having conceived of losing Sakura becomes unable to bear thinking of it.

findings.highlight: I was too afraid to stop lying to you
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩を騙すのも、それを止めてしまうのも怖くて
findings.governingReading: 先輩を騙すのも、それを止めてしまうのも怖くて names both sides of her paralysis.
findings.explanation: The paired fear of lying and ending the lie becomes only fear of stopping it.

findings.highlight: everyone around me was so scary
findings.evidenceJa: まわりはみんな怖いコトだらけ
findings.governingReading: まわりはみんな怖いコトだらけ describes surrounding things/situations as full of fear, not every nearby person as frightening.
findings.explanation: Everything around Sakura being frightening becomes everyone being scary.

findings.highlight: I'm sure I would have been fine with that.
findings.evidenceJa: けど、俺はこれで良かったと信じている
findings.governingReading: これで良かった says the present revelation was good; それだと describes the counterfactual continued suffering had she stayed undiscovered.
findings.explanation: Disclosure being the right outcome becomes being fine with the preceding unrealized separation.

findings.highlight: I'll keep forgiving Sakura, even if no one else does.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜の代わりに桜を許し続ける
findings.governingReading: 桜の代わりに桜を許し続ける directly answers her inability to stop blaming herself.
findings.explanation: Forgiving Sakura in her own stead loses the substitution for self-forgiveness.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜は抱きとめた腕を振り解かない
findings.governingReading: 桜は抱きとめた腕を振り解かない is her choice not to shake off his arms, preceding her wish to remain.
findings.explanation: Sakura not releasing the embrace becomes Shirou not stopping it.
